sources.entry: A list of /uses pages detailing developer setups, gear, software and configs

summary.title: /uses
summary.one_liner: A directory of developer "/uses" pages, where many engineers publish their setups, gear, software and config choices.
takeaways: The page is an index of many developers' personal /uses pages, each listing their setups, gear, software and configs.
Each entry gives a developer's name, a short self-description, their linked /uses page and a tag list of technologies and roles.
Commonly listed tools across entries include VS Code, Vim/Neovim, Git, Raycast, Obsidian, Linux, macOS, Docker and Figma.
Useful for browsing what tools and stacks other developers choose, but the page itself does not describe the tools in depth.
summary.summary: This page is a directory that links to many developers' individual /uses pages. Each entry lists a person's name, a one-line bio, the URL of their /uses page, and a set of tags covering their roles, languages, frameworks and tools. The entries span frontend, backend, full stack, DevOps, design and hobby interests, so the directory works as a broad survey of what developers use. The page itself contains no detailed setup instructions or reviews, only the index and tags.
